in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: This section shall apply to all rent increases subject to subdivision (a) occurring on or after March 15, 2019

dates.prior_version_note: AB 1482 cap in force since 2019-03-15 (rent increases on/after that date); SB 567 repealed and re-added it, operative 2024-04-01.
AB 1482 just-cause rules applied from 2020 (notice dates July 1, 2020 in text); SB 567 made the section operative 2024-04-01 and AB 1529 amended it effective 2026-01-01.

A one-month-plus-first-month cap (with higher cap for small landlords from AB 12) applied to security collected on/after 2024-07-01; earlier versions had higher caps (two months unfurnished); AB 414 amended it effective 2026-01-01.
The $30 per-applicant fee cap, CPI-adjustable since 1998-01-01, predates the AB 1170 amendment effective 2026-01-01; the CPI-adjusted dollar figure resets annually.
Source of income was a protected basis earlier; SB 329 extended it to housing subsidies/vouchers effective 2020-01-01; SB 267 amended it effective 2024-01-01.

in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: In 2019, California’s Civil Rights Council (formerly the Fair Employment and Housing Council) enacted regulations that took effect Jan. 1, 2020

dates.prior_version_note: No specific California regulation on criminal history in housing screening applied before the regulations took effect 2020-01-01.

in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: These laws, described below, took effect on January 1, 2026.

dates.prior_version_note: Section 16729 was newly added to the Cartwright Act; before 2026 only general antitrust prohibitions applied.
